# Kostiantyn Denysov

## Focus
Release management, CI/CD, database migrations, internal developer tooling, blameless incident reviews, system design, mentoring. TypeScript, Node.js, Go, C#/.NET, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Pulumi, AWS, GCP, Azure, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
